data.body: WAVE 1 CLOSED - FINAL NUMBERS, 20 artifacts / 19 in the comparison (36ab-b649-BLOCK excluded as rebar precheck-only, llm_calls==0, reported separately). Rows/distinct/net-merged/TP/FP/nits/unverifiable: rebar 320/258/+62/123/13/101/21; Compound Eng 306/311/-5/235/3/73/0; superpowers 135/140/-5/97/4/39/0; mini-swe-agent 93/91/+2/60/1/30/0. Precision and materiality: rebar 90%/52% (84% precision if the 11 contradicted-but-unrated indeterminate findings were counted), CE 99%/76%, sp 96%/69%, mini 98%/66%. Severity honesty (own nits marked blocking): sp 3%, rebar 6%, mini 17%, CE 33%. Metric 5, TPs only rebar found: 69. Metric 6, TPs rebar missed: 236 - of which 233 are MISSES (a criterion covers it and did not fire) and only 3 are genuine GAPS. BLOCK/PASS discrimination is weak or absent across the board: rebar 62/61, CE 124/111, sp 54/43, mini 33/27 - no arm cleanly separates a plan rebar blocked from one it passed. Of the 236 issues rebar missed, 183 were found by exactly ONE arm and only 13 by three, so the reviewers remain near-disjoint at full sample.
